name: Geechs Inc.
summary: Geechs Inc., along with its affiliated companies, operates across diverse sectors including IT staffing, gaming, and multimedia. The enterprise is structured into four distinct divisions: IT Freelance Matching, Game Development, x-Tech Solutions, and Seed Tech Innovations. It delivers specialized information resources to IT professionals seeking freelance opportunities. Furthermore, Geechs is involved in the conceptualization, creation, and management of mobile game applications. The company also produces video content leveraging augmented reality and other advanced technologies, and manages Gridge, a golf-focused digital platform. Additionally, it offers Soda Tech, a software-as-a-service solution for corporate digital transformation and IT talent development, alongside various programming education programs. Established in Tokyo, Japan, in 2007, Geechs Inc. maintains its headquarters there.
